pages.title: Image

pages.title: Checker
pages.description: Generates a clean checker pattern for quick masks, tiling tests, and scale reference.

pages.title: Gradient
pages.description: Builds a simple directional, radial, or circular gradient source for masks and value ramps.

pages.title: Polygon
pages.description: Creates parametric polygon shapes with controllable sides, scale, and edge behavior.

pages.title: Shape
pages.description: Generates primitive procedural shapes for high-contrast masks and form blockouts.

pages.title: Solid Color
pages.description: Outputs a uniform color fill used as a flat base layer or blend backdrop.

pages.title: Text
pages.description: Renders text glyphs as an image source for decals, labels, and mask-driven layouts.

pages.title: Paint
pages.description: Lets you paint freeform strokes over a selectable background using an interactive brush overlay.

pages.title: Atlas Pack
pages.description: Packs up to 16 input images onto a grid to create a single atlas texture.

pages.title: Atlas Split
pages.description: Splits an atlas texture into individual cell outputs based on a grid layout.

pages.title: Shape Extrude
pages.description: Extrudes a 2D shape into a 3D heightmap with bevel, profile, and rotation controls.

pages.title: Fractal Noise
pages.description: Generates multi-octave noise for terrain-like breakup, roughness masks, and natural material variation.

pages.title: Noise
pages.description: Outputs uniform random grayscale noise for grain, dithering masks, and stochastic variation passes.

pages.title: Perlin Noise
pages.description: Produces smooth gradient noise for organic shapes, cloud patterns, and soft mask modulation.

pages.title: Voronoi
pages.description: Builds cell-based distance patterns for cracks, stone segmentation, and tiled region masks.

pages.title: Simplex Noise
pages.description: Produces isotropic noise with fewer directional artifacts than Perlin for organic material variation.

pages.title: Gabor Noise
pages.description: Produces textured noise from Gabor wavelets for synthetic fur, brush strokes, and fibrous material effects, with fractal FBM support.

pages.title: Crystal Noise
pages.description: Generates crystalline crack patterns with branching segments radiating from cell centers for shattered glass or mineral vein effects.

pages.title: BnW Spots
pages.description: Generates black and white spot patterns using a multi-layer cell-based spot grid for organic speckle, dither, or stipple effects.

pages.title: Splatter Circular
pages.description: Scatters a pattern in a circular distribution.

pages.title: Tile Generator
pages.description: Creates configurable tile layouts with grout-like spacing for bricks, panels, and floor pattern bases.

pages.title: Auto Levels
pages.description: Auto-normalizes luminance range by remapping darkest and brightest pixels to improve contrast quickly.

pages.title: Combine RGBA
pages.description: Combines separate R, G, B, and optional A inputs into a single packed color texture.

pages.title: Combine HSB
pages.description: Combines normalized hue, saturation, and brightness masks into an opaque RGB texture.

pages.title: Combine Alpha
pages.description: Merges a color input with a separate alpha mask to produce a composited RGBA output.

pages.title: Gradient (Dynamic)
pages.description: Maps values through editable gradient stops to art-direct color ramps directly in-graph.

pages.title: Gradient Map
pages.description: Recolors grayscale input by sampling a gradient ramp, ideal for stylized material palettes.

pages.title: Grayscale
pages.description: Converts color input to grayscale intensity for mask extraction and value-driven downstream nodes.

pages.title: Histogram Range
pages.description: Remaps histogram bounds to isolate a value band and expand it across the output range.

pages.title: Histogram Scan
pages.description: Moves a scanning threshold window through tonal values to create animatable mask slices.

pages.title: Histogram Select
pages.description: Selects a narrow intensity region around a pivot value for precise tonal masking.

pages.title: HSL Adjustment
pages.description: Adjusts hue, saturation, and lightness for fast global color correction and palette iteration.

pages.title: Invert
pages.description: Inverts channel values to flip light/dark relationships for negative masks and quick alternates.

pages.title: Levels
pages.description: Manually remaps black, mid, and white points for controlled contrast and tonal balancing.

pages.title: Palette Extract
pages.description: Extracts dominant colors from the input to build a reduced palette for downstream quantization.

pages.title: Palettize
pages.description: Constrains an image to a fixed palette for posterized, stylized, or limited-color looks.

pages.title: Quantize
pages.description: Reduces tonal precision into discrete value steps for banded gradients and retro shading.

pages.title: Separate RGBA
pages.description: Splits RGBA input into independent R, G, B, and A outputs for per-channel processing.

pages.title: Separate HSB
pages.description: Splits an image into normalized hue, saturation, and brightness grayscale masks.

pages.title: Separate Alpha
pages.description: Separates color and alpha into distinct outputs so coverage can be edited independently.

pages.title: Threshold
pages.description: Converts values to a binary mask around a cutoff, useful for hard selections and stencils.

pages.title: Curves
pages.description: Applies curve-based tonal remapping for fine-grained contrast shaping across the value range.

pages.title: Box Blur
pages.description: Applies an even box blur to soften detail, spread masks, or prepare maps for blending.

pages.title: Directional Blur
pages.description: Blurs along a chosen direction to create motion streaks or anisotropic smearing effects.

pages.title: Radial Blur
pages.description: Blurs outward or around a center point for zoom, spin, and lens-like smear effects.

pages.title: Blur HQ
pages.description: Runs higher-quality blur sampling for smoother falloff with fewer blocky artifacts.

pages.title: Non-Uniform Blur
pages.description: Applies a customizable blur driven by an external map with anisotropy and asymmetry controls.

pages.title: Anisotropic Kuwahara
pages.description: Applies edge-aware anisotropic smoothing for painterly stylization while preserving major shape flow.

pages.title: Highpass
pages.description: Isolates high-frequency detail by removing low-frequency content, useful for sharpening workflows.

pages.title: Channel Swizzle
pages.description: Reassigns each output RGBA channel from any input channel or a constant zero or one.

pages.title: FXAA
pages.description: Smooths jagged shape edges with fast approximate anti-aliasing.

pages.title: Median
pages.description: Removes impulse noise while preserving edges using neighborhood median filtering.

pages.title: Sharpen
pages.description: Enhances local contrast around edges to recover crispness after blur or resampling.

pages.title: Slope Blur
pages.description: Smears along gradient direction from a slope input to create erosion-like directional breakup.

pages.title: Coordinates Transform
pages.description: Reprojects UV coordinates with scale, rotation, and offset controls before sampling.

pages.title: Directional Warp
pages.description: Offsets pixels along a vector direction driven by an intensity map for flow distortion.

pages.title: Multi Directional Warp
pages.description: Applies directional warp multiple times in opposite directions and blends the results.

pages.title: Kaleidoscope
pages.description: Mirrors and rotates wedges around a center to generate radial symmetry patterns.

pages.title: Mirror
pages.description: Reflects the image across configurable axes for seamless symmetry and mirrored layouts.

pages.title: Quick Tile
pages.description: Tiles the input with seam-aware transforms for repeatable patterns and texture atlasing.

pages.title: Clone Stamp
pages.description: Copies pixels from a source point into a target brush region for scan cleanup.

pages.title: Quad Transform
pages.description: Warps an image to an arbitrary four-corner quad for perspective-style remapping.

pages.title: Skew
pages.description: Shears the image horizontally or vertically to create angular perspective distortion.

pages.title: Trapezoid Transform
pages.description: Applies trapezoid perspective warping to taper one side of the sampled image.

pages.title: Transform
pages.description: Performs core 2D transform operations like translate, rotate, and scale in one node.

pages.title: Safe Transform
pages.description: Transforms tiled images with pixel-snapped offsets and crisp nearest-neighbor sampling.

pages.title: Image Sample
pages.description: Samples an image with normalized UV coordinates supplied by a color map.

pages.title: Vector Warp
pages.description: Displaces pixels with red and green vector-map channels for precisely directed distortion.

pages.title: Warp
pages.description: Displaces sampling coordinates with a warp map to bend shapes and break up repetition.

pages.title: Swirl
pages.description: Rotates pixels around a center point with distance-weighted intensity for spiral distortion.

pages.title: Spherize
pages.description: Warps pixels outward (pinch) or inward (expand) around a center point for spherical lens effects.

pages.title: Bevel
pages.description: Generates beveled height and normal outputs from input masks for edge definition and relief.

pages.title: Curvature
pages.description: Calculates convex and concave curvature cues from surface detail for wear and mask generation.

pages.title: Distance
pages.description: Computes distance-to-feature fields for falloffs, edge bands, and expansion masks.

pages.title: Dilate / Erode
pages.description: Expands or contracts binary masks with a signed radius slider.

pages.title: Edge Detect
pages.description: Extracts edge lines from luminance changes to build outlines and feature masks.

pages.title: Emboss
pages.description: Simulates raised or recessed relief lighting from height-like input to emphasize form.

pages.title: Flood Fill
pages.description: Labels connected regions to produce per-island IDs, bounds, and region analysis outputs.

pages.title: Flood Fill Random Grayscale
pages.description: Assigns random grayscale values per flood-filled region for quick island separation masks.

pages.title: Flood Fill to Grayscale/Color
pages.description: Samples one grayscale or color value per flood-filled region, then fills the region with it.

pages.title: Flood Fill to BBox Size
pages.description: Converts Flood Fill bounding-box dimensions into a grayscale per-region size map.

pages.title: Flood Fill To Index
pages.description: Converts Flood Fill region IDs into a grayscale index map.

pages.title: Flood Fill to Gradient
pages.description: Converts flood-filled regions into directional gradients for procedural directional masks.

pages.title: Ambient Occlusion
pages.description: Approximates ambient occlusion from height data to add contact shadowing and depth cues.

pages.title: Auto Crop
pages.description: Finds content bounds and fits the result to the canvas.

pages.title: Normal Combine
pages.description: Combines detail from two normal maps with normal-aware math.

pages.title: Normal Map
pages.description: Converts height detail into tangent-space normals for lighting-aware material workflows.

pages.title: Blend
pages.description: Combines two inputs with selectable blend modes and opacity-style control.

pages.title: Height Blend
pages.description: Blends surfaces using height-aware masking to preserve layered material relief.

pages.title: Average Blend
pages.description: Averages multiple inputs into a balanced composite, useful for noise and detail mixing.

pages.title: Switch
pages.description: Outputs one of two inputs based on a control state for branching material variants.

pages.title: Multi Switch
pages.description: Selects one input from multiple branches, enabling indexed graph routing.

pages.title: Input
pages.description: Defines external input ports that feed data into a reusable subgraph interface.

pages.title: Instance
pages.description: References another saved graph and executes it as a nested node with mapped ports.

pages.title: Output
pages.description: Declares external output ports that expose selected results from the current subgraph.

pages.title: Float
pages.description: Emits a constant float scalar for driving numeric parameters and math-style controls.

pages.title: Bool
pages.description: Emits a constant boolean flag for toggles and conditional branch controls.

pages.title: Int
pages.description: Emits a constant integer for stepped parameters, indices, and discrete selectors.

pages.title: Time
pages.description: Emits the current animation time as seconds, a frame index, or normalized progress.

pages.title: Enum
pages.description: Emits a selectable enum option for mode switching and indexed logic.

pages.title: Vec2
pages.description: Emits a constant 2D vector for offsets, directions, and coordinate parameter inputs.

pages.title: Math
pages.description: Performs mathematical operations on two values.

pages.title: Dot
pages.description: Creates labeled reroute points to organize noodle paths without changing signal data.

pages.title: Frame
pages.description: Groups related nodes inside a labeled frame to improve graph structure and readability.

pages.title: Comment
pages.description: Places textual annotations on the canvas to document intent, notes, and TODOs.
